build_VCTEntropyModel: build a VCTEntropyModel with custom num_channels, context_len, and d_model hyperparameters for video compression
run_VCTEntropyModel_forward: run the VCTEntropyModel forward pass with an unquantized latent and previous latents to get perturbed output and bits
run_VCTEntropyModel_compress: run the VCTEntropyModel compress method to autoregressively encode a latent into compressed strings and count bits
run_VCTEntropyModel_process_previous_lat: run process_previous_latent_q to pre-process a quantized latent through the encoder for efficient context conditioning
run_VCTEntropyModel_update: run the VCTEntropyModel update method to refresh entropy bottleneck CDF values after training for compression
